Extract of proceedings in Shanghai Special District Court for Monday, 3rd. June 1930.
Case No. 576/30 Station 3099 Prosecutor Judge McNeill

Accused: Tsang Ta Ji ( ) Age 30. Secretary.

Application: Application is made for the custody of the accused on a charge of being member of a gang of communist bandits, operating in the vicinity of Kong Ying, Kiangsu. Compt.-Kong Ping Sung, Inspector of Bandit Suppression Force.

Proceedings:
Mr. Paul du appeared for the Police.
Mr. Hui:-The accused was arrested at 6a.m. 31- -1. He is wanted by the Chinese authorities as they allege that he is a communist bandit & has committed many crimes at Kong Ying, Kiangsu. The representative has brought no despatch warrant & no evidence so I ask the Court to remand the case for further inquiries.
Rep. Tong Ping Sung:-I received information that the accused is a communist & bandit & has committed many crimes at Kong Ying & he is implicated by another man arrested at Kong Ying last year, & when he knew that he was wanted he ran away to Shanghai.
Wit. Tan Ti Chang:-I know the accused, he is a communist & a bandit. He belongs to a gang who demand money, if they do not get it they set fire & then burn the houses.
Wit. Too Pon Fung:-I am a detective at Kong Ying, I belong to the same family as the unt of accused. His real name is Zung Zau Yoong, I know his uncle, too Kwai Seong. The accused is a communist & a bandit & has committed many crimes.
Wit. Jan Yan Pao:-I do not know accused I only helped to arrest him.
Accused:-My name is not Zung Zau Yoong & I have no uncle named Lee Kwai Seong. I know nothing about communists or bandits & I have never committed any crimes at Kong Ying.
Mr. Hui:-I ask the Court to remand the case for the appearance of Lee Kwai Seong.

Decision: Remand till 11-6-31 a.m. for trial
L.R.
（签名）

上海特区地方法院庭审记录摘录，日期为 1930年6月3日星期一。
案件编号 576/30 捕房 3099 检察官 法官 McNeill

被告： Tsang Ta Ji ( ) 年龄 30岁。秘书。

申请： 申请羁押被告，指控其为在江苏孔营附近活动的共产主义匪帮成员。申请人 - Kong Ping Sung，剿匪部队督察。

庭审过程：
Paul du 先生代表警方出庭。
Hui 先生：- 被告于凌晨6点被捕，日期为 31- -1。中国当局通缉他，因为他们声称他是共产主义匪徒，并在江苏孔营犯下多起罪行。代表未带来递解令状，也未提供证据，因此我请求法庭将案件延期审理，以便进一步调查。
代表 Tong Ping Sung：- 我收到情报称被告是共产主义者和匪徒，并在孔营犯下多起罪行，且去年在孔营被捕的另一名男子供出了他，当他得知自己被通缉后，便逃往上海。
证人 Tan Ti Chang：- 我认识被告，他是共产主义者和匪徒。他属于一个勒索钱财的团伙，如果得不到钱，他们就放火烧毁房屋。
证人 Too Pon Fung：- 我是孔营的一名侦探，我与被告的叔叔同宗。他的真名是 Zung Zau Yoong，我认识他的叔叔 Too Kwai Seong。被告是共产主义者和匪徒，并犯下多起罪行。
证人 Jan Yan Pao：- 我不认识被告，我只是协助逮捕了他。
被告：- 我的名字不是 Zung Zau Yoong，我也没有名叫 Lee Kwai Seong 的叔叔。我对共产主义者或匪徒一无所知，也从未在孔营犯下任何罪行。
Hui 先生：- 我请求法庭延期审理，以待 Lee Kwai Seong 出庭。

裁决： 延期至 31年6月11日上午 受审
L.R.
（签名）

At 8-30.a.m. 1-6-31. Inspt Wong Ping Sung of the Bandit Suppression Force of Kong Ying, Kiangsu, brought to this station one named Tsang Ts Ji, whom he had arrested on Foochow Rd. The Inspt stated that the man had been identified by an informer who accompanied him as one of a band of robbers operating in the vicinity of Kong Ying. He also produced a letter addressed to the local City Authorities instructing that assistance be given to the Inspt in effecting the arrest of several men named therein, one of who was the accused. As it was stated that this band were part of a communistic army, the Special Branch were informed and a statement was later taken from the accused by L.S.Golder. In this the accused stated that he resided at 917. E.Hanbury Rd. and acted as secretary of of a school at that adress. Prior to making this statement he had stated that he worked at a school at 23. E.Hanbury Rd, but on being taken to that adress the female principal and other occupants stated they did not know him. | | Name of investigating officer. | | | Initials of Senior Detective. | | This report is to be forwarded to Headquarters on the morning after arrest. ( Loh You
Tsang Ts Ji alias Zung Zau Yoong alias
D.S. 118 R.M. Golder.
Anwhei.
C.D.I. Kuh.
Lousa 1-6-31

My name is Tsang Ts Ji ( 张 之 棋 ) I am a native of North
Gate, Dung Zung Hsien, Anwhei, aged 30, single and employed
as a clerk in the Tsung Koong Yah Yau ( 尊 孔 学 校 )
Confucius School, No 917 Hanbury Road, where I reside.
At the age of eight I began to study in the Anwhei Middle
School at Dung Zung ( 桐 城 ) I took up the study of
Chinese classics and English and continued to study until I
was 23 years of age . During my period of schooling I res-
ided at home with my parents, Tsang Kung Loong ( 张 广 龙 )
my father and Tsang Tau Sze ( 张 道 氏 ) my mother.
I have a very fair knowledge of the Chinese language and
can read and write a little English , but am at present out
of practice in the la.ter language. My father paid all my
school fees and when I left at the age of 23 I continued to
live with my parents in Dung Zung ( 桐 城 ) In the year
1930 I asked permission to come to Shanghai and eventually
left for this city on February 22nd arriving here by steamer
on February 25th. Mt father did not wish me to leave home
as he operates a rice shop in Dung Zung and is in a fair way
of business. I came to Shanghai at the advice of one Tsong
Zing Nyoch ( 章 静 玉 ) aged about 27, native of Shanghai,
I met this man in my native place some years ago and kept
in touch with him. Early last year he wrote to me and told me
that he had obtained a position as a teacher in the Tsung
Koong Yah Yau school ( 尊 孔 学 校 ) and asked me to come to
Shanghai and take up the position of clerk for the school.
On arrival in Shanghai on February 25th 1930 I went straight

( Loh You
Tsang Ts Ji 别名 Zung Zau Yoong 别名
D.S. 118 R.M. Golder.
安徽。
C.D.I. Kuh.
老闸 31年6月1日

我叫 Tsang Ts Ji ( 张 之 棋 ) ，我是安徽桐城县北门人，现年30岁，未婚，受雇于汉密尔顿路917号尊孔学校 ( Tsung Koong Yah Yau ) 担任职员，我就住在那里。
八岁时，我开始在安徽桐城中学就读。我研习中国经典和英语，并持续学习直到23岁。在求学期间，我与父母同住家中，父亲是 Tsang Kung Loong ( 张 广 龙 ) ，母亲是 Tsang Tau Sze ( 张 道 氏 ) 。
我的中文知识相当不错，能读写少量英语，但目前后者生疏了。我的父亲支付了我所有的学费，当我23岁离校后，我继续与父母住在桐城。1930年，我请求允许来上海，最终于2月22日离开此地，并于2月25日乘轮船抵达。我父亲不希望我离家，因为他在桐城经营一家米店，生意尚可。我来上海是听从一位名叫 Tsong Zing Nyoch ( 章 静 玉 ) 的建议，他约27岁，上海人。我几年前在家乡认识此人，并一直保持联系。去年年初，他写信给我，告诉我他已在尊孔学校 ( Tsung Koong Yah Yau ) 获得教师职位，并邀请我来上海担任该校职员。
1930年2月25日抵达上海后，我直接前往

-2-
to the Tsung Yoong Yah Yau, met Tsong Zing Myoeh and took
up position as clerk for which I was to receive a salary
of $15.00 per month. Since my arrival in Shanghai I have
resided permanently with Tsong at No 917 Hanbury Road.
My duties in the school are to keep the letters and such
correspondence that the school undertakes in proper order.
I have three friends in Shanghai who I have known for
many years namely:-
(1) Wong Wai Yah (王蔚霞 ) aged 25 , native of
Anwei. residing in the Chinese City and employed
in the Ching Hwa Iron works, near the West Gate,
Nantao. I met this man in my native place when I
was attending the Anwei Middle School.
(2) Tsang Ah Sing (張大新 ) aged 32, native of
Anwei. residing on Avenue Road. This man is
employed as an assistant in a piece-goods shop
but I do not know the address. I have not seen
this man in Shanghai and only have his address
through his parents who gave it to me before I
left Anwei in 1930.
(3) Tsong Ling Myoeh (李靜玉 ) with whom I am
living.
The persons residing at the Tsung Koong Yah Yau School
are as follows:- Tsong Ling Myoeh (李靜玉 ) a
teacher( aforementioned ) Koo Tsung (顧貞 ) wife of
the operator of the school who at present in the South
Sea Islands and an old Amah whose name I am not aware of.

尊孔学校 ( Tsung Yoong Yah Yau ) ，见到 Tsong Zing Myoeh，并担任职员职务，月薪为15.00美元。自抵达上海以来，我一直与 Tsong 常住在汉密尔顿路917号。
我在学校的职责是整理学校往来的信件及此类通信，使其井然有序。
我在上海有三位相识多年的朋友，即：-
(1) Wong Wai Yah (王蔚霞 ) ，25岁，安徽籍，居住在华界南市西门附近的清华铁厂 ( Ching Hwa Iron works ) 。我在安徽中学就读时在家乡认识此人。
(2) Tsang Ah Sing (張大新 ) ，32岁，安徽籍，居住在爱文义路 ( Avenue Road ) 。此人在一家布店担任助手，但我不知道具体地址。我在上海未见过此人，仅通过其父母在我1930年离开安徽前提供的地址得知。
(3) Tsong Ling Myoeh (李靜玉 ) ，我与其同住。
居住在尊孔学校的人员如下： Tsong Ling Myoeh (李靜玉 ) ，教师（前述）； Koo Tsung (顧貞 ) ，学校经营者之妻，其夫目前在南洋群岛；以及一名老佣人，其名不详。

pages.en:
-3-
On the morning of my arrest I left my residence □ No 917
Hanbury Road and was intending to visit Wong Wai Yah (
王蔚茂 ) in the Chinese City. I left the house at about
6 a.m. and was proceeding South along Hokien Road when I
was arrested and taken to Louza Police Station. So far I
do not know the reason for my arrest I have never been in
the hands of the Police before . I have never been a mem-
of the Communist Party nor had any dealing with its mem-
bers. I have never seen the man who arrested me until
this morning on Hokien Road.

(This is my true statement.)

Signed. Tsang Ts Ji (       )
pages.zh:
-3-
在我被捕的当天早晨，我离开位于汉伯里路（Hanbury Road）917号的住所□，打算去华界拜访王蔚茂（Wong Wai Yah）。我大约在早上6点离开家，沿福建路（Hokien Road）向南行走时被捕，并被带往老闸捕房。截至目前，我不知晓被捕原因。我此前从未被警方拘捕过。我从未加入共产党，也未曾与其成员有过任何往来。直到今天早上在福建路上，我才第一次见到逮捕我的那个人。

（这是我的真实陈述。）

My name is Tsang Ts Ji ( 张之祺 ) I am a native of North
Gate, Dung Zung Hsien, Anwhai, aged 30, single and employed
as a clerk in the Tsung Koong Yah Yau ( 尊孔学校 )
Confucius School, No 917 Hanbury Road, where I reside.

At the age of eight I began to study in the Anwhei Middle
School at Dung Zung ( 桐城 ) I took up the study of
Chinese classics and English and continued to study until I
was 23 years of age . During my period of schooling I res-
ided at home with my parents, Tsang Kung Loong ( 张广就 )
my father and Tsang Jau Sze ( 张赵氏 ) my mother.

I have a very fair knowledge of the Chinese language and
can read and write a little English , but am at present out
of practice in the latter language. My father paid all my
school fees and when I left at the age of 23 I continued to
live with my parents in Dung Zung ( 桐城 ) In the year
1930 I asked permission to come to Shanghai and eventually
left for this city on February 22nd arriving here by steamer
on February 25th. My father did not wish me to leave home
as he operates a rice shop in Dung Zung and is in a fair way
of business. I came to Shanghai at the advice of one Tsong
Zing Nyoeh ( 章静玉 ) aged about 27, native of Shanghai,
I met this man in my native place some years ago and kept
in touch with him. Early last year he wrote to me and told me
that he had obtained a position as a teacher in the Tsung
Koong Yah Yau school ( 尊孔学校 ) and asked me to come to
Shanghai and take up the position of clerk for the school.
On arrival in Shanghai on February 25th 1930 I went straight

我叫张之祺（Tsang Ts Ji），籍贯安徽桐城县北门，现年30岁，未婚，受雇于汉伯里路917号尊孔学校（Tsung Koong Yah Yau / Confucius School）担任书记员，我也居住于此。

我八岁时开始在安徽桐城中学就读。我研习中国经典和英语，一直学习到23岁。在求学期间，我与父母同住，父亲是张广就（Tsang Kung Loong），母亲是张赵氏（Tsang Jau Sze）。

我的中文水平相当不错，能读写少量英文，但目前后者的运用已生疏。我的父亲支付了我所有的学费，当我23岁离校后，我继续与父母住在桐城。1930年，我请求允许前往上海，最终于2月22日启程，乘轮船于2月25日抵达此地。我父亲不希望我离家，因为他在桐城经营一家米店，生意尚可。我是听从一位名叫章静玉（Tsong Zing Nyoeh）的建议来到上海的，他约27岁，上海人。几年前我在家乡结识此人，并一直保持联系。去年初，他写信告诉我，他已在尊孔学校谋得教师职位，并邀请我来上海担任该校的书记员。1930年2月25日抵达上海后，我直接前往

CRIME REGISTER No. (One form to be used for each person arrested) "A" Division Louza Police Station. 1st June. 31. 19 | Name, age occupation and address of person arrested. | Tsang Ts Ji.(花之祺) alias. Zung Zau Yoong.(鄭朝陽) Loh Yue. Secretary. 917. E.Hanbury Rd. Native of Anwei. | | :--- | :--- | | Arrested by | Inspt Wong Ping Sung. Bandit Suppression Force. | | Date and place where arrest took place. | 1-6-31. Foochow Rd. | | Crime Register No. of offence for which arrested. (If an arrest for outside authorities details of offence for which arrested). | Assistance to Chinese Authorities.
At 8-30.a.m. 1-6-31. Inspt Wong Ping Sung of the Bandit Suppression Force of Kong Ying, Kiangsu, brought to this station one named Tsang Ts Ji, whom he had arrested on Foochow Rd. The Inspt stated that the man had been identified by an informer who accompanied him as one of a band of robbers operating in the vicinity of Kong Ying. He also produced a letter addressed to the local City Authorities instructing that assistance be given to the Inspt in effecting the arrest of several men named therein, one of who was the accused. As it was stated that this band were part of a communistic army, the Special Branch were informed and a statement was later taken from the accused by D.S.Golder. In this the accused stated that he resided at 917. E.Hanbury Rd. and acted as secretary of of a school at that adress. Prior to making this statement he had stated that he worked at a school at 23. E.Hanbury Rd, but on being taken to that adress the female principal and other occupants stated they did not know him. | (SA) ac 3/6 Name of investigating officer. Initials of Senior Detective. Rcd This report is to be forwarded to Headquarters on the morning after arrest. (OVER) It will be returned for particulars on back to be completed. In case of arrests for outside authorities, no Crime Register Number to be shown.

F. 22-E. 上海公共租界工部局警务处。 逮捕报告。 犯罪登记号 （每名被捕者使用一份表格） “A”分区 老闸捕房。 1931年6月1日。 19 | 被捕者姓名、年龄、职业及地址 | Tsang Ts Ji.（花之祺）别名 Zung Zau Yoong.（鄭朝陽） Loh Yue. 秘书。汉伯里东路917号。安徽籍。 | | :--- | :--- | | 逮捕人 | 黄炳松（Wong Ping Sung）督察。剿匪队。 | | 逮捕日期及地点 | 1931年6月1日。福州路。 | | 被捕罪行的犯罪登记号。（如果是应外部当局要求逮捕，需详述被捕罪行）。 | 协助中国当局。
1931年6月1日上午8:30，江苏公营（Kong Ying）剿匪队督察黄炳松将一名叫张之祺（Tsang Ts Ji）的人带到本捕房，该人是他于福州路逮捕的。该督察称，随同他前来的线人指认此人为在公营附近活动的一伙强盗的成员。他还出示了一封致当地市政当局的信函，指示协助督察逮捕信中列名的数人，其中一人即为被告。由于声称这伙强盗是共产主义军队的一部分，政治部（Special Branch）获悉此事，随后由警探长古尔德（D.S. Golder）对被告进行了问话并记录供词。在此供词中，被告称其居住于汉伯里东路917号，并在该地址的一所学校担任秘书。在作此陈述之前，他曾称其在汉伯里东路23号的一所学校工作，但当被带至该地址时，女校长及其他住户表示并不认识他。 | (SA) ac 3/6 调查警官姓名。 高级警探缩写。Rcd 本报告须于逮捕次日早晨呈送总部。（续下页） 本报告将退回以补全背面详情。 若是应外部当局要求进行的逮捕，无需填写犯罪登记号。

在我被捕的当天早晨，我离开位于汉伯里路917号的住所，打算去华界拜访王蔚霞（Wong Wai Yah）。我大约在早上6点离开家，沿福建路（Hokien Road）向南行走时被捕，并被带往老闸捕房。截至目前，我不知晓被捕原因。我此前从未被警方拘捕过。我从未加入共产党，也未曾与其成员有过任何往来。直到今天早上在福建路上，我才第一次见到逮捕我的那个人。

（这是我的真实陈述。）

签名：张之祺（Tsang Ts Ji）

pages.en:
Despatch from the Shanghai Special District Court.
No. 6950.                                      June    5,      1.

To Commissioner of Police,
           S. M. P.

Sir,

        I have to inform you that I am in receipt of a
letter No.679 from the Kiangsu Provincial Government
informing me the arrest of a gang of communists in
Kiang-ying and also forwarding a list of names and
particulars of those who are at large. I have to
request that you be good enough to give instructions
to the various police stations to effect the arrest
of these persons whose names and particulars are given
in the attached list.                          before
                                              They are to be brought this
Court when they are arrested.

                        President Yang Shao Shun.
pages.zh:
上海特区法院公函。
第6950号。                                      1931年6月5日。

致警务处处长，
           上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：

        兹通知阁下，本人收到江苏省政府第679号来函，告知在江阴（Kiang-ying）逮捕了一伙共产党员，并附上了在逃人员的名单及详细资料。现请阁下惠予指令各捕房，依据附件名单中所列姓名及资料，逮捕相关人员。
                                              这些人被捕后须解送至本
                                              法院。

                        院长 杨绍顺。
